The text "NCGICC" appears below the grid, with the letters "NC" in blue and "GICC" in green.

content.description: This choropleth map illustrates parcel update statuses across North Carolina counties, color-coded by the most recent quarter of completion. A legend indicates that most regions are categorized as 2025 Q2, with smaller groups marked as processing, 2024 Q4, or 2025 Q1. Select counties such as Rand, Hoke, Scotland, and Bladen are highlighted in distinct colors corresponding to different update timelines.
